should_fail.message: I'll cut the callout on slide 2 down to bloated file sizes and font substitution.

slides.purpose: Evidence beat 1 — Responsive design and device flexibility
slides.content_brief: Show that HTML slides adapt fluidly to any screen size — laptop, tablet, phone, or conference-room projector — while PowerPoint locks content to a fixed canvas. Use a chart-plus-commentary layout with a conceptual visual comparison of responsive rendering vs. cropped/stretched .pptx output across device sizes Add a callout on the two worst PowerPoint pain points: bloated file sizes (8–15 MB average) and font substitution.
slides.assumes: The audience knows responsive web design exists but may not have connected it to presentations
slides.hands_off: HTML slides look perfect on every screen without manual resizing
